title: A self state is the pattern an agent is at one subjective moment

statements.text: A self state, called an observer state in the 2020 paper, is the abstract pattern one can be at a given subjective moment. Everything to be said about an agent at that moment, including every inference about its past or future, is fixed by its self state. In the bit model self states are finite binary strings.

sources.quote: There is a set S of “self states”, the collection of patterns that one can be at any given subjective moment.
Having a first-person perspective means to be in some observer state at any given (subjective) moment.
